How to learn — 3 rounds

Round 1 · Retrieve. Look at the film scene and the meaning, then say the exact phrasal verb out loud before you flip. Say the gapped sentence with the correct form (watch the red warnings: past! passive! -ing!). Stuck? Press 💡 Hint first. Only flip when you have said something.

Round 2 · Sort. Mark every card honestly: ✓ I know it! or ↩ Still learning. Then press 🎯 Practise tricky ones and repeat until the tricky pile is empty. Too easy? Switch to 🖼️ Front: picture only and recall the verb from the scene alone.

Round 3 · Retell. Pitch two films from memory. Ex 6 film: a girl brought up by her grandmother stows away on a ship, comes up with a plan… use at least 5 verbs. Ex 7 film: a vampire story: who breaks out, who is holed up, who tracks down and fights off whom? Bonus: use three of the verbs about your own life this week (I looked after… / I came up with… / time went by…).
